reviews.title: Solid No Frills Motherboard
reviews.comment: Pretty good build quality. Plenty of fan connectors for an ATX mid tower build. Really easy installation and comes with a software tool that automatically installs drivers (just be sure to uncheck the option to install Norton they sneak that in there). Only complaint is that the boot times are a little long even with a fast gen 4 drive, but we're only talking about maybe 30 seconds and still pretty fast compared to the old days of HDDs and SATA SSDs.
reviews.author: Edward

reviews.title: Unkown status at this juncture...
reviews.comment: Purchased this because it supports 6 SATA ports for AM5 CPU's. Its for a future upgrade once AM5 CPU prices along with DDR5 RAM relax. Currently running AM4. Supports dual monitor GPU as long as the CPU supports them. I don't do games but I do quite a bit of video editing so I need some speed. You need a 1KW PSU,
reviews.author: Lee

reviews.title: Great Mobo with brittle plastic and lake of DDR5 dual channel flexibility
reviews.comment: My B650 pro wifi has been great since building my new PC in October.  I just have one tiny beef I’d like to share.  I had a Samsung sata SSD go bad which resulted in hanging after BIOS.  While troubleshooting, I was swapping RAM slots and I got a bit rushed and broke slot 4 (the plastic used for tabs and interfaces on this mobo are very thin and brittle compared to my 2017 Gigabyte mobo).  My mobo will not boot with sticks in 1 & 3 so I am now stuck in single channel, populating slots 1 and 2.  I strongly dislike the fact that there is no flexibility for dual channel and I am annoyed with the quality of plastic they are using even though I take full responsibility for breaking things.
reviews.author: Hebo Samsonite

reviews.title: DOA - CPU light stays on
reviews.comment: Absolute garbage...  While there might be a good number of these boards that do work, please have a Google search for "MSI PRO B650-P red CPU light is on" and look at all the people that are having exactly the same problem that I'm currently experiencing, too many.  This board was no good out of the box, no socket pins are bent, I upgraded their bios per instructions, and even what's the thing to sit for hours because they said sometimes it takes a long time for it to configure itself on first power up. ALL FAILS!  All other components were tested another machine can work just fine, this board is DOA.  MSI wants me to send back a brand new motherboard at my expense for them to evaluate.  I don't think so.  Apparently it's not just this model that suffers this problem, so avoid MSI.  I'm very disappointed, I've been an MSI builder for many years,  hundreds of computers which I sold retail.  This is the first time they have let me down, it will be a long time before they fix their reputation after this. 🤮
reviews.author: VvTheDuckvV
